note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All texts, provisions, levels and readings are fictional placeholders; jurisdiction unspecified. Relationships are drawn only as supplied (causal only when supplied); the link state is supplied, never inferred; no instrument is shown to be valid, lawful or binding and the hierarchy is only displayed.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: The instrument and the enabling document are pulled apart into their parts; plain relations (contains, refers to, placed as supplied) and one communication (a proposed reading) are drawn; a small lens traces instrument → clause → passage → document → hierarchy and the passage enlarges; the cord's tag shows 'authorization supplied'.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: different fictional texts, the supplied link state 'authorization to be checked' (open clip, pencil outline on the passage), a relationship supplied as a sequence (the clause is read before the passage), the tracer starting from the hierarchy and the reference clause as focus.

passages.text: The committee may issue a notice order on meeting dates.
